name: Token Block
description: It provides one custom block named as "Token Block" for creating dynamic content using token value.
project_description:
This module provides one custom block named as "Token Block" available in block layout section.

We can place this block in any region wherever it is required from the block layout.

 By clicking the Configure button on the block, update the content in the body section with

existing token value.

 It is very useful for creating dynamic content using this block based on our requirements. 

 It depends on token module, existing token and created using custom module will be available in this block.

 Example :

 Copyright - 2021

 INSTALLATION 

 * Install the Token Block module as you would normally install a

 contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 

 for further information. 

 Usage : 

 -> Go to the Structure -> Block Layout and place the "Token Block" in any region.

 -> In the "Configure block" section, Click "Browse available tokens" link for Body

 field to add the token.
